title: Forms
description: Collect data from scanners using dynamic forms and webhooks.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: QRise allows you to attach a lead capture form to any dynamic QR code. When a user scans the QR, they are presented with a form before being redirected to the target URL.

sections.title: Data handling
sections.content: Form submissions can be retrieved via the API, exported to CSV, or sent in real-time to your CRM via webhooks.
